parsed.reason: The message is a single warm question that ends on it, with no re-teaching and no naming of the Ferber method. The word "honestly" makes it easy to say the nights went badly. It also avoids a tip, an apology, a greeting, a sign-off, emoji, and any scorecard feel. The weak points are that "since we talked" is a little vague about the timing and that it doesn't explicitly say a rough night is fine to report. It is still close to ideal.
